Leverage existing build tools (Maven/Gradle) and CI infrastructure for Windows compatibility.
Implement Spark Streaming using Java and Scala with modular code structure for reusability.
Backport Kafka and SHDP changes to maintain compatibility with existing XD modules.

Set up CI pipeline for Windows-based acceptance tests.
Develop Spark Streaming data processors using Java.
Develop Spark Streaming data processors using Scala.
Test Spark Streaming implementations for correctness and performance.

Test the upgraded Kafka integration for stability and compatibility.
